description: Change an existing DNS record in place — e.g. repoint an A record when a VM gets a new IP. Prefer this over adding a second record. Only the fields you pass are changed. Record ids come from the zone detail (GET /agent/dns/zones/{id}).

data.description: New value, e.g. the new IP address

dry_run.description: Preview the action without executing it. Returns what would happen, including cost estimates. Always dry-run first for anything that costs money.

name: edge_update_dns_record
